Name: Please Remember My Marriage
Author: nraittanna
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#a64d79]Please, Remember My Marriage[/color]
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Villagers from the Valley don't seem to talk much about your marriage, so I added some dialogue lines for them. Most dialogues will appear when you have their hearts maxed (8 for bachelors/ettes and 10 for the others).[/size][size=3]
[/size]
[b][size=5]Installation[/size][size=5]:
[/size][/b][list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patc[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]her[/url] must be installed.[/size]
[*][size=3]﻿[/size][size=3]Download the mod and unzip it.[/size]
[*][size=3]Place the folder [b][CP] Please, Remember My Marriage [/b]in your Mods folder.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5][b]﻿Compatibility:[/b][/size][size=3]
This mod is compatible with all mods on a technical level, but if you have other dialogue mods, they might overwrite each other.

If you enjoy playing with my mods, please consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/nraittanna]buying me a coffee [/url][img]https://forums.nexusmods.com/public/style_emoticons/dark/smile.gif[/img]
[/size]
[size=4][b][color=#d5a6bd][center]Please let me know in the comments if you encounter any bugs, and I hope you enjoy even more your experience in Stardew Valley with this mod![/center][/color][/b]
[b][color=#d5a6bd]
[/color][/b]
[/size]
